rationale: Evidence from iteration 4 (kd 0.5, kp 3.5, base_speed 1.6, sensors at y = 0.07, x = -0.04 to +0.04, sensor_size 0.012, line_loss last_direction): score 64.17, the best so far, but all 60 trials still went off track. max_error was 0.0611 (oval), 0.062 (s-bend) and 0.0619 (slalom), all just above the 0.06 m floor. Line_loss_events were 1 per run on every track. Steering_oscillation was 0.108 on the oval and 0.151 on the s-bend and slalom. Raising kd from 0.3 to 0.5 gave about +1.5 points and cut oval oscillation, but it did not bring max_error under 0.06 m. Lookahead (y = 0.07) and wider sensors were real gains, but neither has removed the single line-loss event per run. The evaluator's rule for this state is: if max_error still exceeds 0.06 m with line loss of 1 or more at kd 0.5, change line_loss from last_direction to search_left or search_right. That is the test I am making. Steering_oscillation sits at about 0.15 on two tracks, which is borderline for the kp reduction, so I hold kp at 3.5 to keep this a single-variable test. Change: controller.line_loss last_direction -> search_right (signal fixed at +1, steering the robot left). I chose search_right over search_left because the oval is a loop with mainly left-hand bends, so the outer-edge drift it recovers from should be to the right of the line; this direction is a judgement, not a measured result. Everything else is unchanged: geometry, kp 3.5, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6. Expected result: line_loss_events fall to 0, which should keep max_error near or below 0.06 m and raise progress. Hypotheses: (H1) search_right reduces the single line-loss event per run, so max_error falls below 0.06 m on at least the s-bend and slalom; (H2) if search_right makes loss worse (more events or larger max_error), the opposite direction, search_left, is the next test; (H3) if line loss stays at 1 with no change, the blind spot is in sensing and the next lever is sensor geometry or kd. Measurements wanted: completion, progress, completion_time, max_error, rms_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation, controller_errors. Next step if runs stay on track but do not finish: raise base_speed toward 2.0. If steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.15 while on track: lower kp toward 2.5.
